# Current practice {#Currentpracticeofdatafiltering-Currentpractice}

Table 1: examples of where countries have applied these filters:

+-------------+----------------+----------------------+--------------+---------+----------+----------+------------------+
| Country\    | Index formula  | Commodity group\     | Outlier filter         | Dumping filter\     | Low sales filter |
| \           |                | \                    |                        | \                   |                  |
+-------------+----------------+----------------------+--------------+---------+----------+----------+------------------+
| Upper Limit | Lower Limit    | Price Filter         | Sales Filter | Lambda  |          |          |                  |
+-------------+----------------+----------------------+--------------+---------+----------+----------+------------------+
| Poland      | Chained Jevons | \                    | 3            | 0.25    | \-       | \-       | 1.25             |
+-------------+----------------+----------------------+--------------+---------+----------+----------+------------------+
| Norway      | GEKS-Törnqvist | Groceries            | 4            | 0.25    | 0.9      | 0.2      | \-               |
+-------------+----------------+----------------------+--------------+---------+----------+----------+------------------+
| UK          | GEKS-Törnqvist | Railfares; used cars | 3            | 0.33    | \-       | \-       | \-               |
+-------------+----------------+----------------------+--------------+---------+----------+----------+------------------+
